plugins.name: slacklens
plugins.description: Personal Slack triage dashboard. Atomic cache writes with one-level backup, suspicious-refresh detection (keeps old cache when Slack returns 0 unexpectedly), tolerant per-result parsing, DELTA refresh, stale-cache warnings, versioned cache, append-only refresh log, doctor with --fix / --json modes.
